name: IR Safety: Contrast Radiation and Consent

reference.source: Safari reference; Handbook of Interventional Radiological Procedure; Interventional Radiology Cases (topic maps only; prose rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Hydration protects at-risk kidneys while metformin continues unless injury develops; gadolinium minimises below eGFR 30, foetal risk stays negligible below about 50 mGy under ALARA, SIR thresholds gate punctures by platelets and INR, and Montgomery consent with WHO checks closes the loop.

NSF versus allergy by timing and kidneys
